In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

Vico, with the help of his new methodological approach, was one of the first thinkers who tried to understand the world of origin, which, according to him, was not an idyllic place, but a place of fear, anguish and conflicts, and which was made by different historical phases and social conflicts.
, for Vico, the primitive world was the one of the origins of humanity, and it was a world in which there were no social classes, and the only social group was the family.
Vico was one the first philosophers to understand the complexity and the contradictions of the primitive world, which is not only a world of myths but also of social and class conflicts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, in the primitive world, there was no idyllic and peaceful life, as it was believed by many authors of the time, but there was a world characterized by conflicts, by social and class differences and by a great fear of the gods.

Vico's thought represents the starting point for the study of the primitive world, as it has been developed in the twentieth century by several authors, who have tried to reconstruct it through the anthropological and ethnological methods.
the primitive world was a world in which the human being was not a rational being, but a being who lived in a world of fears, needs and fantasies.

Vico was the first to understand the importance of the social dimension and of the role that the social conflict played in the history of mankind.
